text: Welcome to iWeGain! Track every set and watch your progress grow.
Warm up for 5–10 minutes before lifting heavy.
Add a little weight or one more rep each week: that's progressive overload.
Good form beats heavy weight. Lower the load if your technique breaks down.
Muscles grow while you rest. Aim for 7–9 hours of sleep.
Spread your protein intake across the day to support recovery.
Consistency wins. Three workouts a week beat one perfect week a month.
